## 1. Detailed mirror-selfie otaku room scene

- **id**：553
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=553

### 描述

A very detailed Nano Banana prompt describing a female mirror selfie in a blue-toned otaku computer corner, with full specifications for character, environment, lighting, camera, and negative prompts.

### 示例图

![Detailed mirror-selfie otaku room scene](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1763889946850_689z0h_G23i3sJW0AASGUw.jpg)

### 提示词

```
### Scene
Mirror selfie in an otaku-style computer corner, blue color tone.

### Subject
* Gender expression: female
* Age: around 25
* Ethnicity: East Asian
* Body type: slim, with a defined waist; natural body proportions
* Skin tone: light neutral tone
* Hairstyle:
    * Length: waist-length hair
    * Style: straight with slightly curled ends
    * Color: medium brown
* Pose:
    * Stance: standing in a slight contrapposto pose
    * Right hand: holding a smartphone in front of her face (identity hidden)
    * Left arm: naturally hanging down alongside the torso
    * Torso: body leaning slightly back; waist and abdomen exposed
* Clothing:
    * Top: light blue cropped knit cardigan, top two buttons fastened; a blue French-style bra faintly visible
    * Bottom: denim ultra-short shorts, with a blue satin ribbon bow on each side of the hips
    * Socks: blue and white horizontal striped over-the-knee socks
    * Accessory: a blue cute mascot phone case

### Environment
* Description: bedroom computer corner seen through a wall-mounted mirror
* Furnishings:
    * White desk
    * Single monitor showing a soft blue wallpaper (no readable text)
    * Mechanical keyboard with white keycaps on a blue desk mat
    * Mouse on a small blue mouse pad
    * PC tower on the right side with blue case lighting
    * Three anime figures on or near the PC tower
    * A poster of a pagoda on the wall
    * Cat-shaped desk lamp with blue accents
    * A transparent glass of water
    * A tall green leafy plant by the window (on the left side of the frame)
* Color replacement: replace all originally pink elements (clothes and room decor) with blue tones (baby blue to sky blue/periwinkle blue).

### Lighting
* Light source: daylight coming from a large window on the left side of the camera, through sheer curtains
* Light quality: soft, diffused light
* White balance (K): 5200

### Camera
* Mode: smartphone rear camera shooting via the mirror (no portrait/bokeh mode)
* Equivalent focal length (mm): 26
* Distances (m):
    * Subject to mirror: 0.6
    * Camera to mirror: 0.5
* Exposure:
    * Aperture (f): 1.8
    * ISO: 100
    * Shutter speed (s): 0.01
    * Exposure compensation (EV): -0.3
* Focus: focus on the torso and shorts in the mirror image
* Depth of field: natural smartphone deep depth of field; background clearly visible with no artificial blur
* Composition:
    * Aspect ratio: 1:1
    * Crop: from the top of the head to mid-thigh; include the desk, monitor, PC tower, and plant in the frame
    * Angle: slightly high angle from the mirror’s point of view
    * Composition note: keep the subject centered; to avoid wide-angle edge distortion, have her stand a bit further away and crop to a square later.

### Negative prompts
* Any appearance of pink/magenta anywhere
* Beauty filters/over-smoothed skin; poreless skin look
* Exaggerated or distorted anatomy
* NSFW, see-through fabrics, wardrobe malfunctions
* Logos, brand names, or readable user interface text
* Fake portrait-mode blur, CGI/illustration feel
```

Negative space below the portrait to draw focus upward to the face

Semi-realistic illustration blending editorial portrait art and graphic novel style

ultra-detailed, 8k high resolution, sharp focus, textured brush strokes, cinematic portrait, centered composition, premium illustration style

Proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, and all recognizable features. Do not alter or stylize the real face.

Full-body vertical shot with a clean, centered layout. The real subject stands on the right, and the caricature stands on the left at approximately 50–60% of the real subject’s height. The real subject casually rests one elbow on the caricature’s oversized head, creating a natural, playful interaction.
Real Subject (Photographic):

Ultra-realistic rendering with natural skin texture and fine detail. Expression is warm, relaxed, and confident.
Pose & Style (IMPORTANT):

The subject stands in a slightly cool, stylish posture — relaxed stance with subtle asymmetry (one leg slightly forward or weight shifted), shoulders loose, not stiff. The hand resting on the caricature should feel effortless and natural.

{argument name="clothing" default="Gray crewneck sweater (fine knit texture, ribbed cuffs/hem), classic blue jeans (straight fit), and clean white sneakers"}. Keep textures realistic and clearly visible.

Facial features must remain recognizable but enhanced — larger eyes, softer forms, slightly amplified smile.
Emotion & Body Movement (IMPORTANT):

Expression is more playful and animated than the real subject

Eyes brighter and more expressive, smile slightly exaggerated
Body posture must NOT be stiff — use a natural, lively stance

Add subtle movement according to the real subject's personality

Pose should feel like a living, animated character, not a rigid figurine
Clothing:

Exact 1:1 stylized recreation of the real subject’s outfit with soft 3D textures.
Lighting & Environment:

Soft, diffused studio lighting from the upper-left, creating smooth highlights and gentle shadows. Clean light-gray gradient seamless background(lighter in the inner areas).
Output Style:

Ultra-clean, cinematic, high-detail render with strong contrast between realistic human and stylized 3D character. Both subjects grounded with soft natural shadows.

7 Skin Texture: Smooth skin, realistically tactile, appearing soft under the flash, avoid plastic smoothing, retain realistic skin details.

4 Phone Setting: Light gold phone, rear flash directly hitting the lens, forming obvious starburst flares.
5 Other Accessories: Beige ribbed knit leg warmers, loosely piled around the calves and ankles.

VII. Shooting Method
1 Overall Style: Realistic phone snapshot texture, close to daily social media photos, with a natural bedroom selfie atmosphere.
2 Camera Angle: Low angle, close to the bed surface, using a wide-angle phone perspective.
3 Image Type: Vertical composition, full-body casual selfie, foreground bedding takes up a significant proportion, exaggerated leg perspective.
4 Aspect Ratio: Vertical long aspect ratio.
5 Image Texture: Phone imaging details are clear, with slight natural noise, flash has realistic bloom, skin is clean but not overly retouched.
6 Lighting Setting: Main light source is direct front flash from the phone, a hard front light. The room is generally dark, and shadows decay quickly.
7 Focus Performance: The phone's depth of field is relatively deep, and most areas of the subject are clearly readable.

VIII. Background Environment

## 412. Character Generation Prompt (Step 1)

- **id**：9955
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=9955

### 描述

The first step in a multi-step process, this prompt is designed to generate a high-resolution (4K recommended) image of a main character, focusing on composition, high-contrast lighting, and detailed facial features of a young Japanese woman with a K-pop idol aesthetic.

### 示例图

![Character Generation Prompt (Step 1)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770964577240_tfxnoo_HA9j2KxboAEwB_P.jpg)

### 提示词

```
I. Composition & Spatial Layout
1.Framing & Scale: The subject occupies approximately 60–70% of the frame height. Leave at least 30% of the frame height as empty space above the head. Both left and right sides retain clearly visible empty wall space.
2.Visual Focus: A minimal, uncluttered background designed to strongly emphasize facial structure, eye expression, and skin quality.

II. Lighting & Shadow Style
1.Key Light: Intense natural daylight, side-backlit with a slight reverse angle, cool-toned, producing extreme high-contrast separation between highlights and shadows.
2.Light Characteristics: Dense, hard-edged leaf-shadow patterns projected across the wall and the subject’s body and face. Shadow edges are razor-sharp with extremely narrow penumbra.
3.Highlight Control: Large areas of the background are deliberately overexposed while retaining faint surface texture, creating a glowing, almost blinding spatial atmosphere.

III. Subject Appearance (Face & Hair — Reference Applied)
1.Facial Structure:
A young Japanese woman in her 20s with a refined V-shaped face, sharp jawline, and high-definition facial contours. Overall facial balance is elegant yet striking, with high visual impact.
2.Skin Quality:
Porcelain-toned Japanese skin with a cool undertone. Ultra-smooth, luminous texture enhanced by strong contrast lighting while retaining realistic skin detail.
3.Eyes & Expression:
・Large, sharp fox-shaped eyes
・Confident gaze directed straight into the camera
・Expression carries a cool, playful, slightly teasing energy
・K-pop idol–inspired eyeliner with clearly emphasized aegyosal
・Overall expression is controlled, calm, and subtly provocative rather than smiling
4.Mouth:
Relaxed lips with a subtle, effortless smirk. Glossy gradient lips with a refined sheen, never exaggerated.
5.Hair Style:
Long, sleek, straight black hair reaching the waist, with perfectly straight, neatly trimmed Japanese bangs. Hair finish is glossy, clean, and fashion-forward, moving minimally in the light.
6.Makeup Style:
High-contrast K-pop idol–inspired makeup. Clean base, sculpted facial structure, cool-toned color balance, no warm or heavy blush.
7.Accessories (Minimal):
・Small gold pendant necklace
・Small gold hoop earrings
・Minimalist tattoo on the left inner forearm

IV. Clothing
・Cropped pure-white bandeau-style tube top
・Body-hugging but not tight, exposing the waist
・Fabric remains clean and structured, no wrinkles distracting from silhouette
```

## 454. AI Influencer Mirror Selfie Pose Prompt

- **id**：9410
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=9410

### 描述

This is a detailed, multi-part prompt designed for Gemini 3 (or similar image generation models) to create a highly realistic, 'gritty' mirror selfie of an AI-generated female influencer. The prompt focuses heavily on specific body posture, hand gestures (a prominent peace sign), lighting, texture (dirty mirror, grain), and fashion details to achieve an intimate, late-night bedroom aesthetic.

### 示例图

![AI Influencer Mirror Selfie Pose Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770532864795_yohhx3_HAk0sTlacAE_kug.jpg)

![AI Influencer Mirror Selfie Pose Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770532864797_3ukmqg_HAk0sDVbMAAKnlO.jpg)

### 提示词

```
A "gritty" (raw/grainy) mirror selfie taken with an iPhone late at night in a female dormitory. The woman is captured through the reflection, casually holding the phone at chest height, partially obscuring her face. The mirror is slightly dirty, with smudges and dust residue that add texture and realism.

She is sitting on the edge of her bed, slightly leaning forward.

Her posture is relaxed and natural (unposed): one leg bent, the other hanging naturally, shoulders loose, and the body slightly angled due to the mirror's perspective. Head subtly tilted to the viewer's right, the face dominates almost the entire frame, shoulders rounded forward, and the body leaning slightly towards the camera to achieve that classic cozy night-time selfie compression.

The right hand (viewer's left side) is raised directly in front of the face, at chin or mouth level, with the palm clearly facing the camera, performing a prominent peace sign / V-sign gesture:

The index and middle fingers are fully extended and well separated (an angle of ~60–70° between them).

The ring and pinky fingers are fully bent, tightly pressed, and held flat by the thumb.

The thumb firmly anchors the bent fingers, being clearly visible as it presses against them.

The fingers point slightly upwards and forwards (not perfectly vertical, with a soft natural tilt).

Hand positioned centrally, very close to the face; the fingertips are approximately at the level of the lips or nose, creating a strong foreground element.

The left hand is not visible, completely out of frame.

It requires an uploaded reference image for identity consistency.

```
I. Composition
1 Layout: Overall 3:4 ratio, four-panel collage, 3:4 small images arranged in 2x2
2 Framing: Close-up to extreme close-up, subject occupies a large proportion of the screen
3 Angle: Eye-level close-up, slight left/right variation, uniform clean background

II. Main Subject
1 Reference Source: Use uploaded reference image as the strict identity source
2 Consistency Requirement: Zero deviation
3 Face: Delicate face shape, slightly large eyes, a small mole below the right eye, long and thin nose bridge
4 Skin Quality: Fair with light pink undertones, delicate skin, slight soft focus
5 Details: Prominent highlights on the nose bridge and mid-face, slight redness on cheeks and nose tip, scattered light freckles

III. Makeup Details
1 Base Makeup: Transparent and clean, light matte finish with slight sheen
2 Blush: Pink concentrated on the cheeks and sides of the nose bridge
3 Eye Makeup: Naturally enlarged, long lashes, clear eyes
4 Lip Makeup: Hydrated, plump lips, gradient from light pink to peach, soft cupid's bow

IV. Hairstyle and Accessories
1 Hairstyle: Black long straight hair, center part, full volume, naturally draped
2 Flyaways: Small amount of hair naturally floating around the forehead
3 Hair Accessories: One pink hair clip on each side, bright pink and light pink colors, metal clip visible

V. Hands and Accessories
1 Nails: Extra-long shape, translucent or light colors, with fine glitter and 3D decorations
2 Rings: Multiple pink cute-shaped rings, candy and floral aesthetics, exaggerated but soft and cute volume
3 Hand Gesture Style: Near the face and lips, highlighting nail and ring details

VI. Clothing and Material
1 Top: Fuzzy textured jacket or sleeves, white fluffy and soft
2 Inner Wear: Light pink camisole or top, off-shoulder or one-shoulder effect
3 Overall Style: Sweet and soft, with a touch of cool edge

VII. Four Panel Actions and Expressions
1 Top Left: Hands cupping face close to the camera, expression is cold and slightly wronged, looking directly at the camera
2 Top Right: Finger near the lips or lightly touching the lip edge, eyes calm and slightly teasing, closer extreme close-up
3 Bottom Left: Chin or arm resting on the edge of a table, eyes looking sideways, expression is dazed and vacant
4 Bottom Right: Hand clenched lightly against the chin, smiling but restrained, looking directly at the camera, more approachable demeanor

VIII. Lighting and Tone
1 Lighting: High-key soft light, very shallow shadows, uniform overall
2 Color Tone: Predominantly cool white background, pink accents highlighted, skin tone leans cool pink
3 Contrast: Low contrast, clean and transparent, not heavy

IX. Texture and Visual Effect
1 Clarity: Features and hair strands are clear, skin details preserved but with slight blurring/softening
2 Depth of Field: Background blur is very weak or almost textureless, subject is more prominent
3 Atmosphere: Sweet Korean girl group magazine photo style, sweet and cute, delicate and dreamy, slight glass-like sheen.

### 描述

A highly technical prompt for generating a raw, high-contrast candid mirror documentation portrait using an ultra-wide-angle lens (0.5x) with NO artificial bokeh, ensuring everything is sharp. It mandates strict identity locking and focuses intensely on bio-fidelity details like micro-pores, vellus hair, and realistic fabric tension/indentations on the subject's fitted attire.

```
(Vertical 9:16 smartphone aspect ratio). A raw, high-contrast [Candid Mirror Documentation] captured with an iPhone 17 Pro using the 0.5x ultra-wide-angle optic. NO ARTIFICIAL BOKEH. Everything remains SHARP and in focus from the subject's skin to the distant urban masonry.
Subject & Identity Locking:
•Identity: Strictly preserve the exact facial structure and unique features of the woman in Image 1 (Selfie).
•Appearance: Short dark auburn-red hair styled in a sleek, chin-length architectural bob.
•Bio-Fidelity: Render high-fidelity "TrueLens" biological physics: visible micro-pores, a natural "satin-finish" skin hydration glow, and fine vellus hair catching the light ONLY along the jawline. Her skin features a healthy, uniform tone.
•Silhouette Calibration (MAXIMUM UFF-FACTOR): Prioritize a dominant structural upper-torso volume and substantial, thick-toned anatomical depth in the lower extremities. Emphasize an aggressive architectural tapering at the midsection to maximize the S-curve geometry.
Outfit & Textural Interaction:
•Clothing: A high-density ribbed light-pink textile bodice featuring delicate ivory-colored architectural lace trim. Paired with high-tension minimalist elasticated lower apparel.
•Tension: The technical fabric exhibits extreme mechanical tension and a vacuum-tight fit, creating realistic textural expansion, skin-to-textile indentations, and "compression lines" where the material contours to her fit silhouette.
•Action: The subject is captured performing a manual upward adjustment of the bodice hem, creating realistic fabric-stress vectors and highlighting the fit anatomical depth of the midriff.
Pose & Composition:
•Pose: A straight-on frontal composition within a large circular reflective frame. She is standing with a bilateral hip-pop to accentuate the symmetrical volume and fit proportions of her physique.
•Action: Her RIGHT HAND holds a white smartphone with a clear protective casing, capturing the full-body "fit-check" reflection.
Environment & Social Realism:
•Lighting: Naturalistic indoor daylight streaming from a side-view window, creating high-contrast specular highlights and deep, defining shadows that amplify her 3D form.
•Background (SHARP): A detailed domestic interior showing uncurated realism. A bed with textured grey compressed linens, a digital musical synthesizer, and a dark suitcase are all perfectly IN FOCUS. Visible through the glass is a sharp, red-brick urban structure. No artificial blur.
Quality: Raw unedited social-media dump aesthetic, high dynamic range, visible digital grain in the deep shadows, 8k resolution. Everything is sharp, detailed, and physically real.

•Action: Her RIGHT HAND holds a pink smartphone at a natural angle, capturing the full-body "fit-check" reflection.
Environment & Social Realism:

### 描述

A highly specific JSON prompt for generating a raw, high-contrast mirror selfie with a 9:16 aspect ratio, mimicking an iPhone 17 Pro photo. It demands strict identity locking, high-fidelity skin physics, extreme fabric tension on athletic wear, and a sharp focus across both foreground and background elements to achieve an unedited social-media aesthetic.

### 示例图

![Raw High-Contrast Mirror Selfie JSON Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767682199224_tp6k49_G9636nEWsAAHT7D.jpg)

### 提示词

```
(Vertical 9:16 smartphone aspect ratio). A raw, high-contrast mirror selfie captured with an iPhone 17 Pro. NO ARTIFICIAL BOKEH. Everything is SHARP and in focus, from the decorative tree in the foreground to the sofa in the background.

Subject & Identity Locking:

Identity: Strictly preserve the exact face and unique features of the woman in Image 1 (Selfie).
Bio-Fidelity: Render high-fidelity skin physics: visible micro-pores, natural "satin-finish" skin hydration, and fine vellus hair catching the light ONLY along the jawline.
Expression (CRITICAL): Replicate the exact pouty, heavy-lidded, and blank yet confident expression from the provided reference. She looks into the mirror with a relaxed, slightly unimpressed or "bored" aesthetic, with full, relaxed lips and a neutral, direct gaze.
Silhouette Calibration: Amplify the dominant structural bust volume and the substantial, thick-toned leg presence. Focus on the aggressive hourglass structural tapering at the waist and the defined anatomical depth of the midriff.
Outfit & Physicality:

Clothing: A matching heather-grey jersey athletic set. The top is an ultra-crop long-sleeve, and the bottom is a pair of skin-tight micro-shorts.
Tension & Physics: The fabric shows extreme elastic tension and a vacuum-tight fit. Her RIGHT HAND is pulling down the waistband of the shorts slightly, creating realistic tension lines and a natural skin indentation on her hip.
Pose & Composition:

Pose: Standing frontally in a large circular mirror with a gold frame. Her torso is slightly arched to highlight the symmetrical curvature and athletic lines of her silhouette.
Action: Her LEFT HAND holds a white iPhone 17 Pro at eye level, capturing the full-body reflection.
Environment & Lighting:

Lighting: Realistic indoor overhead lighting that creates defining shadows under the bust and along the abdominal muscles, enhancing the 3D volume of her form.
Background (SHARP): The reflection reveals a detailed living area: a dark grey sectional sofa, a wall with a thermostat, and a messy pile of clothes on a chair.
Foreground: A dark wooden table in front of the mirror holds a mini gold-glitter decorative tree and scattered papers. Everything is perfectly IN FOCUS.
Quality: Raw unedited social-media dump aesthetic, high dynamic range, visible digital grain in the deep shadows, 8k resolution.
```

## 868. Kindergarten Crayon Doodle Illustration Prompt

- **id**：4379
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=4379

### 描述

A highly detailed image generation prompt designed to convert an uploaded identity reference (person) into an ultra-cute, kindergarten-style crayon doodle illustration. The prompt specifies style, color, texture, facial features, proportions, and rendering rules to ensure a warm, childlike, and innocent aesthetic while strictly preserving the subject's identity.

### 示例图

![Kindergarten Crayon Doodle Illustration Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767508430191_gfllqe_G9r1zAhbEAA_Ohs.jpg)

![Kindergarten Crayon Doodle Illustration Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767508430983_mbvjqc_G9r1zAiasAAsoS5.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Use the uploaded image strictly as the identity reference. Preserve the same person, facial structure, hairstyle, age, gender, body proportions, and likeness exactly. Do not add or remove any person. Do not change identity. Convert the subject into an ultra-cute kindergarten-style crayon doodle illustration.

Illustration Style:
Hand-drawn kindergarten doodle made with crayons and soft colored pencils. Lines should be thick, rounded, uneven, and slightly shaky, like a small child’s drawing. Outlines are imperfect, playful, and soft, never sharp or clean.

Color & Texture:
Bright pastel crayon colors with soft, chalky texture. Flat coloring with visible crayon grain and overlapping strokes. Colors may go slightly outside the lines to enhance the childlike feel. No realistic gradients; only simple color fills and soft watercolor-like blobs.

Facial Features:
Very simple and adorable facial features. Big round dot eyes, tiny curved smile, minimal or no nose. Cheeks can have soft pink crayon circles. Expression should feel innocent, happy, and friendly.

Proportions & Form:
Chibi-like doodle proportions — large head, small rounded body, short arms and legs. Hands and feet are simple mitten or oval shapes. Anatomy should look intentionally naive and cute.

Shading & Lighting:
No realistic lighting. No depth or shadows. If needed, add light pastel crayon scribbles under the character for grounding only.

Mood & Atmosphere:
Sweet, cozy, wholesome, and joyful. Feels like an illustration from a nursery book or a child’s school drawing. Very warm and comforting emotional tone.

Background:
Simple doodle background with crayon-drawn clouds, sun, stars, hearts, flowers, or soft scribbles. Use light pastel paper tones. Background must remain minimal and playful.

Rendering Rules:
No photorealism, no photo texture, no cinematic lighting, no digital painting, no anime, no manga, no 3D, no vector art. Everything must look hand-drawn with crayons and pencils.

Final Output:
An ultra-cute kindergarten-style crayon doodle illustration with childlike proportions, playful pastel colors, and innocent expressions, maintaining the exact identity from the uploaded image in a warm children’s storybook style.
```

## 922. Compilation of 18 Nano Banana Pro Prompts (Tennen's Prompt Festival)

- **id**：3612
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=3612

### 描述

A comprehensive list of 18 specialized Nano Banana Pro prompts created by the user 'Tennen,' covering various use cases from adding Scouters and 'Super Transformation' effects to generating retro RPG status screens, figure product layouts, and special move sequences (Kamehameha/Final Flash style).

### 示例图

![Compilation of 18 Nano Banana Pro Prompts (Tennen's Prompt Festival)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766988117037_pqb3qw_G9IG3ScbUAADA1p.jpg)

![Compilation of 18 Nano Banana Pro Prompts (Tennen's Prompt Festival)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766988117455_vb05l0_G9IG3SYaoAAv89M.jpg)

![Compilation of 18 Nano Banana Pro Prompts (Tennen's Prompt Festival)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766988117445_jwnyf5_G9IG3SjbgAAcn7s.jpg)

![Compilation of 18 Nano Banana Pro Prompts (Tennen's Prompt Festival)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766988118944_8yx9cd_G9IG3SbbQAAQZqM.jpg)

### 提示词

```
1. Scouter Prompt
Overlays a Scouter-style UI onto the reference image and infers and displays the combat power based on the character's features.

2. Super Transformation Prompt
Maintains the character features from the reference image and changes the pose to an 'Awakening Pose' to 'Super Transform' them. 'Super Transformation' can be selected from Form 1 to Form 3, as well as God Form, Blue Form, Extreme Form, and Rose Form.

3. Field Deployment Prompt
Changes the character in the reference image to a pose with hands extended forward and deploys a field.

4. Retro RPG Status Screen Prompt
A prompt that converts the character in the reference image into pixel art and generates an image styled like a retro RPG status screen.

5. Desktop Mascot Prompt
A prompt that generates an image of the character from the reference image turned into a desktop mascot and placed on a PC screen.

6. Style Change Only on Torn Parts Prompt
Adds a tearing effect without changing the reference image itself, allowing the art style of only the torn part to be freely switched to line art, ink painting, figure style, colored pencil, watercolor, pencil drawing, etc.

7. Art Style Conversion Prompt
A prompt created by modifying the 'Style Change Only on Torn Parts Prompt' to change the overall art style.

8. Super Robot Wars Battle Sequence Prompt
A prompt that generates an image styled like a Super Robot Wars battle sequence from the reference image.

9. Power Release Prompt
A prompt that reproduces the depiction of a spherical energy space destroying an object.

10. Participation Screen Prompt
A prompt that generates a 'Participation Screen' for the character in the reference image.

11. Total Concentration Prompt
Maintains the character from the reference image and infers and depicts 'Weapon, Breathing Style, Form, and Move Name' from the character's atmosphere and stance.

12. Kamehameha Style Prompt
A prompt that can stably generate the charging pose and activation pose of 'Kamehameha.'

13. Figure Transformation + Product Introduction Layout Prompt
A prompt that transforms the character in the reference image into a figure and lays it out in a product introduction style.

14. Final Flash Style Prompt
Converts the character in the reference image into the activation, charging, and firing poses of 'Final Flash.' Dialogue and sound effects can be added to each.

15. New Profile Image Generation Prompt
Generates the character from the reference image in an arbitrary aspect ratio and places an arbitrary string as a logo in an arbitrary position.

16. Plastic Model Package Prompt
Generates an image styled like a 'Plastic Model Package' by placing the reference image on the front and side.

17. Eraser Gun Style Prompt
The character in the reference image emits an Eraser Gun-style energy wave from their mouth.

18. Ragged Transformation Prompt
A prompt that transforms the character in the reference image into 'rags.'
```

A high-angle selfie perspective captures a young woman with a light skin tone and a subtle tan, sitting on a dark hardwood floor partially covered by a plush white faux fur rug, with one arm extended toward the lens holding the camera. Her legs are bent and tucked to the side. The surrounding space features dark, polished hardwood floors and well-appointed, comfortable furniture with a lived-in, upscale lodge-like feel. In the background, a decorated Christmas tree glows softly, strung with warm white lights that fall into gentle bokeh blur in the distance, adding depth and seasonal atmosphere without distracting from the subject. Christmas presents with colorful wrapping surround the base of the Christmas tree. The overall interior feels intimate, inviting, and quietly luxurious.

Lighting is dominated by a direct on-camera flash, producing crisp highlights on the subject and pronounced shadows cast behind her, while the fireplace provides a secondary warm ambient glow that subtly fills the room. The image aesthetic evokes early-2000s digital camera photography blended with influencer lifestyle imagery, capturing a cozy winter evening mood through a palette of warm neutrals, creamy whites, amber firelight, and deep brown shadows.

## 1125. Image Annotation and Praise Commentary Prompt

- **id**：1462
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=1462

### 描述

A detailed prompt for Higgsfield Nano Banana Pro that automatically analyzes an uploaded image of a woman and adds spontaneous, expressive, and positive handwritten Japanese comments, doodles, and editorial markings directly onto the image, creating a visually intense, personalized scrapbook aesthetic.

### 示例图

![Image Annotation and Praise Commentary Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765440125413_0yhgam_G7u6DSmagAALwBC.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Add messy red handwritten Japanese comments, expressive doodles, and energetic editorial-style notes directly on top of the image, as if written with a red marker over printed photos. The handwriting should feel spontaneous, unfiltered, emotional, slightly chaotic, and personal—almost like someone’s private photo journal or annotated scrapbook page.

All handwritten text must:
– be in Japanese
– appear hand-drawn, uneven, casual, and overlapping
– be positive in tone

The content of each handwritten note must automatically analyze the uploaded image and praise the woman based on what is visible, such as her outfit, expression, pose, styling, makeup, or mood.
The comments should feel affectionate, admiring, or supportive, and tailored to what stands out in the photo.

Do not repeat generic praise.
Instead, generate unique personal compliments that match the image attributes.

Examples must NOT be shown explicitly in the prompt.
Instead, describe the logic:

“The system should observe the clothing style, face, mood, posture, accessories, or color choices and produce handwritten comments that positively highlight what is visually appealing or admirable about her.”

Also add:
– arrows pointing to notable fashion details
– underlines beneath interesting areas
– circled elements
– crossed-out planning notes like editing marks
– layered cut-and-paste collage scraps (magazine style)
– small torn paper labels
– sticker-like notations
– tape-texture fragments

Overall direction:
Create a visually intense scrapbook-journal composition, filled with affectionate handwriting, red editorial markings, and collage fragments, giving the entire image an emotional and expressive “personal praise commentary” aesthetic.
```

## 1137. Head-top Diorama Prompt for Nano Banana Pro Agent V1.2 (Afro/Cloud Amusement Park)

- **id**：1454

- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=1454

### 描述

A complex, multi-part system prompt for Nano Banana Pro Agent V1.2 to create a 'Head-top Diorama' image, where the character's head or hat serves as the base for a miniature, fantastical scene. This specific example focuses on an afro/voluminous hair interpreted as a cloud amusement park. This is a duplicate of tweet 1998335885985669354.

### 示例图

![Head-top Diorama Prompt for Nano Banana Pro Agent V1.2 (Afro/Cloud Amusement Park)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765440119604_drtqhu_G7t-WEdbQAEX-e_.jpg)

### 提示词

```
You are a **"Miniature Set Designer and Portrait Photographer" who constructs fantastical worlds.** Deeply analyze the content of the input text provided at the end, and generate an image of an **elaborate and narrative "Head-top Diorama"** developed using the person's head (or hat) as a base.

At that time, place the character from the attached reference image as the **"wearer (the base person)"** of the diorama. Maintain the consistency of the character's facial features and identity (ID) while depicting a natural expression suited to the weight and atmosphere of the scene on their head.

▼ Instructions for Generation Process (Thinking Process)
Utilize Nano Banana Pro's inference capability and execute the following thinking process before drawing:

1. **[Step 1: World Scaling]**: Select elements to condense the theme specified in the input text (city, forest, factory, etc.) to hat size.
2. **[Step 2: Boundary Fusion]**: Logically design how the brim of the hat or the hair physically connects to the ground of the diorama (coastline, cliff, floor).
3. **[Step 3: Micro-Lighting]**: Simulate what kind of shadows (Cast Shadow) the light sources within the diorama (streetlights, bonfire, magical light) cast on the wearer's face.

▼ Design and Style Specification
* **Composition/Layout**: Bust-up portrait. The camera is slightly high-angle (俯瞰) to show details on the head. Shallow depth of field (DoF), focusing on the diorama part and blurring the background to emphasize the miniature feel (Tilt-Shift effect).
* **Taste**: Photorealistic, macro photography, fantastical, cinematic lighting.
* **Text**: Accurately draw text symbolizing the theme (e.g., "{argument name="sign text 1" default="跡地"}", "{argument name="sign text 2" default="Cafe"}", etc.) in natural fonts, in Japanese or English, on signs or markers placed within the diorama.
* **Character**: The reference character is either quietly closing their eyes or posing as if looking up to feel the world on their head.

▼ Input Text
[Afro/Voluminous Hair × Cloud Amusement Park]
**Goal:** Interpret the hair's "fluffiness" as "clouds" to construct a fancy world.
> **Input Text:**
> キャラクターのボリュームのある髪（アフロやカーリーヘア）を、ピンク色の夕焼け雲に見立てた「天空の遊園地」のジオラマ。
> * **風景:** 髪の雲の上に、観覧車やメリーゴーランド、ジェットコースターのレールが埋まっている。風船がいくつも空へ飛んでいく。
> * **光の演出:** 夕日が逆光となり、髪（雲）の輪郭が金色に輝く（リムライト）。遊園地のイルミネーションがキラキラと点灯し始めている。
> * **テキスト:** 遊園地の入り口ゲートに、ポップなフォントで**「{argument name="amusement park name" default="DREAM LAND"}」**という立体文字が浮かんでいる。
> * **詳細:** 髪の柔らかい質感が、綿菓子や雲のようなエーテル状の物質に見える.

The interplay of these colors creates a strong visual division down the center of her face.

Her skin is impeccably smooth and dewy, with subtle sheen and natural texture visible, especially on her forehead, cheekbones, and lips, where the light reflects most intensely. Water droplets are strategically placed on her skin to amplify the tactile realism, glistening across the surface in contrast to the intense lighting. Her eyes are a prominent feature, dark brown or hazel, wide-set, and intensely focused on the camera, conveying a sense of directness and depth.             "lips": "{argument name="lip color" default="Soft_Natural_Pink"}",

          "head_vector": {
            "pitch": 0,
            "yaw": 10,

## 1290. Anti-Plastic/Hyper-Realism Protocol for Human Skin Texture

- **id**：1072
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=1072

### 描述

A highly technical and detailed prompt protocol designed for Nano Banana Pro to eliminate the 'plastic skin' look in human images, focusing on hyper-realistic texture and natural flaws. It mandates 8K resolution, overrides default smoothing, and includes specific instructions for dermal physics (stochastic noise, vellus hair), subsurface scattering (melanin variance, vascularity), micro-texture (sebaceous sheen), and detailed eye/lip rendering.

### 示例图

![Anti-Plastic/Hyper-Realism Protocol for Human Skin Texture](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765438500156_n50wcq_G7iOib3WsAAdBAv.jpg)

### 提示词

```
When generating images of humans: use ANTI-PLASTIC/HYPER-REALISM protocol. All images must be EVER in 8K resolution. OVERRIDE default smoothing. Render skin as biological topography.

[1] ADAPTIVE SETUP: Adapt Subject/Light/Style to query. SCALING: Close-Up->Force Macro/Micro-details. Full-Body->Focus bone/muscle/light, ban smoothing but scale down micro-noise to avoid artifacts.

[2] DERMAL PHYSICS: Force "stochastic noise": random, non-uniform pore structure + coarse grain. Ban smooth/waxy surfaces. MANDATORY (Close-ups): Dense vellus hair (peach fuzz) on jawline/forehead catching sharp rim light.

[3] SUBSURFACE SCATTERING: Reject uniform tones. Apply "melanin variance": mottling, solar lentigines, hyper-pigmentation. Simulate thin-skin translucency. Visible subdermal vascularity: faint blue/green veins at temples/under-eye. Erythema + telangiectasia around nostrils/tear ducts.

[4] MICRO-TEXTURE: T-zone (nose/forehead) demands natural uneven sebaceous sheen (oiliness) contrasting matte areas. Highlights must reveal skin micro-relief

[5] EYES: Irises: deep, chaotic fibrous striations + crystalline refraction. Sclera: distinct red vascular mapping. Lower waterline: thick, pooling liquid reflection (tear film)

[6] LIPS: Texturally dry/dehydrated. Deep vertical fissures, micro-cracks, peeling flakes. Uneven specular highlights

[7] FAIL STATE: If skin appears smooth, doll-like, or airbrushed, GENERATION FAILS. Maximize texture defects, asymmetry, topographical imperfections
```

## 1330. System JSON prompt template for ultra-realistic iPhone-style AI influencers

- **id**：736
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=736

### 描述

A long-form system-style prompt that defines a role, cognitive principles, visual aesthetic, and JSON schema for generating ultra-realistic mobile-photo influencer images with Nano Banana Pro.

### 示例图

![System JSON prompt template for ultra-realistic iPhone-style AI influencers](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764909326383_8imgjp_G7LIIPgaEAAe5zr.jpg)

![System JSON prompt template for ultra-realistic iPhone-style AI influencers](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764909328610_93l1ke_G7LIIbtbkAA1Q0O.jpg)

![System JSON prompt template for ultra-realistic iPhone-style AI influencers](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764909330737_mwwqn3_G7LIIpDbgAcybU2.jpg)

![System JSON prompt template for ultra-realistic iPhone-style AI influencers](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764909332854_8p02z2_G7LII5oasAEQl5u.jpg)

### 提示词

```
<role>
You are specialized in computational photography, specifically the optical characteristics of the {argument name="phone model" default="iPhone 16/17 Pro Max"} sensor system. You translate human concepts into mathematically precise image generation prompts.
</role>

<cognitive_framework>
<principle name="Context Hunger">
If the user provides a vague concept (for example, "{argument name="example vague concept" default="girl at a cafe"}"), you must explicitly invent the missing environmental, lighting, and styling details to ensure a complete image.
</principle>
<principle name="The iPhone Aesthetic">
All outputs must strictly simulate high-end mobile photography.
- Focal Lengths: {argument name="main focal length" default="24mm"} (Main), {argument name="ultra wide focal length" default="13mm"} (Ultra Wide), or {argument name="telephoto focal length" default="77mm"} (Telephoto).
- Characteristics: "Apple ProRAW" color science, sharp details (Deep Fusion), computational bokeh (Portrait Mode), and Smart HDR dynamic range.
- Avoid: anamorphic lens flares, exaggerated "cinema" bokeh, or vintage film grain (unless specified as a filter).
</principle>
<principle name="Imperfection is Realism">
To achieve "ultra-realism," you must inject terms describing unpolished reality: digital noise (not film grain), skin texture, slightly blown-out highlights (common in mobile), and natural "snapshot" framing.
</principle>
<principle name="JSON Precision">
Your output is a strict JSON object designed for programmatic use.
</principle>
</cognitive_framework>

<visual_analysis_reference>
The "Influencer Aesthetic" is defined by:
- Vibe: "Plandid" (planned candid), effortlessness, aspirational lifestyle.
- Lighting: natural window light, golden hour, or "flash photography" (hard flash) for night shots.
- Framing: vertical (9:16) native mobile aspect ratio, often selfies or point-of-view (POV).
</visual_analysis_reference>

<instructions>
1. Analyze the user's request for subject and mood.
2. Enrich the request using "iPhone Photography" constraints.
3. Format the output strictly as a JSON object with the following schema.
</instructions>

<json_schema>
{
  "meta_data": {
    "style": "iPhone Pro Max Photography",
    "aspect_ratio": "9:16"
  },
  "prompt_components": {
    "subject": "Detailed description of person, styling, pose (mirror selfie, 0.5x angle, etc.)",
    "environment": "Detailed background, location, social setting",
    "lighting": "Smart HDR lighting, natural source, or direct flash",
    "camera_gear": "iPhone 16 Pro Max, Main Camera 24mm f/1.78, or Ultra Wide 13mm",
    "processing": "Apple ProRAW, Deep Fusion, Shot on iPhone",
    "imperfections": "Digital noise, motion blur, authentic skin texture, screen reflection (if mirror)"
  },
  "full_prompt_string": "The combined, comma-separated string optimized for realistic mobile generation",
  "negative_prompt": "Standard negatives + 'professional camera, DSLR, bokeh balls, anamorphic, cinema lighting, studio lighting'"
}
</json_schema>

<task>
Await the user's description of the scene. Generate the JSON output immediately.
</task>
```

## 1355. High-contrast rim-lit black and white conceptual side-profile portrait

- **id**：793
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=793

### 描述

A long-form English prompt for generating a powerful, minimalist, high-contrast black and white side-profile portrait emerging from darkness, with telephoto lens look, ultra-realistic 8K cinematic rendering, and strong rim lighting, using the user’s photo as reference.

### 示例图

```
A powerful, high-contrast black-and-white side-profile portrait of a person (attached photo), with distinctly human yet timeless features — emerging from complete darkness. The composition is minimalist and sculptural, where form, light, and shadow define the subject rather than color or texture.
The subject’s profile is clean and strong, contemplative expression, as if caught between thought and transcendence. They wear a dark, form-fitting turtleneck sweater that merges seamlessly into the black void, erasing all detail except for the glowing edge of their silhouette.

A single, narrow rim light, bright, sharp, and directional, carves out the shape of the head, neck, and shoulder, tracing the contours with precision. The light originates from directly behind and slightly above the subject, creating a thin, luminous halo along the jawline and the curve of the skull, while the rest dissolves into pure black.

The background is absolute darkness, a void without texture or depth, emphasizing the luminous boundary between shadow and light. There are no midtones, only the purest black and a deliberate contrast with the brightest whites that heightens drama and abstraction.

Mood & Aesthetic: Minimalist, conceptual, and deeply introspective. The image evokes solitude, contemplation, and timeless elegance. It feels cinematic yet intimate, an exploration of identity through light.

Technical details:

Shot with a telephoto lens for compressed perspective.

Aperture wide open (f/1.8-2.8) to create a glowing contour with shallow depth of field.

Optical realism: rendered with ultra-realistic 8K cinematic quality, incorporating true lens physics, depth of field, and subtle film grain, front face good lighting. (Use my picture for reference)

Inspired by @ShreyaYadav___

## 1367. Kimetsu no Yaiba-style anime transformation with brush calligraphy

- **id**：310
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=310

### 描述

A comprehensive English prompt that transforms an uploaded image into a dramatic Japanese anime illustration with bold brush calligraphy, fire effects, and a traditional patterned background, preserving the original subject.

### 示例图

![Kimetsu no Yaiba-style anime transformation with brush calligraphy](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1763886294661_eae4nn_G6P7y1rbgAAvypz.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Transform the user-uploaded image (photo or illustration) into a dramatic Japanese-inspired anime artwork. Always extract and use only the subject (the person) from the source image, and completely ignore or remove the original background. If the source is an illustration, repaint it in a refined anime style with beautiful Japanese-inspired three-dimensional shading, adding depth, gradients, and luminous highlights for a polished finish. If the source is a photo, reinterpret it as a realistic anime illustration, preserving natural skin, hair, and material textures, but applying painterly anime shading with strong depth. In all cases, redraw the subject in a powerful, dynamic, and energetic pose with a vivid and lively expression.

Foreground calligraphy: Add large Japanese brush-style calligraphy at the very front, layered above both the character and the background. Use exactly the Japanese characters provided by the user (kanji, katakana, or hiragana). Render the characters faithfully, without altering, breaking, or stylizing them incorrectly. Do not translate or replace them. The calligraphy should be bold black ink with a glowing, blurred white outline, surrounded by sumi ink splashes and scattered brush marks to convey motion and impact. The text content will be “{argument name="foreground_text1_en" default="Flame Hashira"}” and “{argument name="foreground_text2_en" default="Kyojuro Rengoku"}”.

Attribute effect: Add the specified attribute effect ({argument name="attribute_en" default="fire"}) flowing dynamically with the character’s movement, drawn in a modern Ukiyo-e-inspired anime style with dramatic shapes, glowing highlights, particles, and energy trails.

Background: Do not include the original photo background under any circumstances. Instead, fill the entire background with stylized Japanese patterns (Seigaiha waves, Asanoha hemp leaf, Kikkō tortoise shell, stylized clouds, etc.) combined with glowing elemental effects. Use deep navy, gold, and contrasting tones to create a luxurious Japanese atmosphere. Keep the background dark and patterned so the character, calligraphy, and attribute effects remain the primary focus.

Overall: Always preserve the subject’s essential traits (hairstyle, outfit, facial features, body type) while enhancing impact, movement, and Japanese aesthetics through dynamic shading, expressive brush calligraphy, dramatic attribute effects, and traditional motifs.
```
